clause_by_clause_review.producer_reason_reviewed: The complete unnumbered command invokes 10 USC 2808 emergency-construction authority for Defense and military departments and requires immediate effectiveness/transmittal/publication. EO13350 expressly revokes EO12734, and section 10 supplies July 30, 2004 at 12:01 a.m. EDT. No earlier own-term sunset or distinct continuing command appears in the original. Completed transmission/publication is an ancillary historical execution, not an independent current command.

inventory_review.scope_note: EO12734 and EO12817 retain full text but merge notice commands with differently timed legal acts; EO12722 needs the stated declaration/definition/notice splits; EO12696 selected text is truncated.

limits: This is AI source review, not an eo-lifecycle-review/v1 independent_human record.
Prospective-authority cessation can be supported while the exact submitted complete first-end claim is rejected.
Original page-image confirmation is not asserted; three EO13350 legal-body rendered pages were independently inspected.
rationale: EO13350 expressly revokes EO12734 and terminates its predicate emergency, with explicit effectiveness July 30, 2004 at 12:01 a.m. EDT rather than July 29 signing. No earlier authority end is shown by the held sources; original EO12722 and EO12724 precede this invocation and are predicates, not later revokers. The NEA savings in EO13350 section 1 preserve accrued actions/duties without continuing a prospective construction invocation. This supports prospective-authority cessation, but the exact submitted inventory conflates one-time notice commands and cannot be upheld in full.

required_corrections_or_open_tasks.reason: The submitted whole scope includes both invocation of emergency construction authority and a separate direction to transmit the order to Congress and publish it. It assigns the entire scope first_end July 30, 2004, while calling completed notice historical. The cited original itself is the November 19, 1990 Federal Register publication, disproving publication as a duty first ceasing only in 2004. No held transmittal-completion evidence establishes its exact first end.
required_corrections_or_open_tasks.required_correction: Split the continuing construction invocation from the one-time publication and congressional-transmittal commands. Preserve July 30, 2004 at 12:01 a.m. EDT for prospective authority under EO13350 sections preamble/10. Establish actual completion/end dates for notice commands with held evidence, or mark the complete exact-date claim unable. Publication issue date supplies a latest completion bound unless actual first completion timing is established; do not invent a congressional transmittal date.

search_scope_limits.limitations: Machine corpus search metadata is a bounded contrary-evidence check, not proof of a current legal predicate. U.S. Code coverage ends 2026-10-09; eCFR uses cutoff point-in-time. Machine hits are not classified as operative current predicates solely by number. The supplied dossier has no attributed current-law leads except EO12722. No additional corpus extraction/acquisition was undertaken.
